text.p: Thomas Tracy was named chief executive officer of Robinson-Humphrey Inc, succeeding Jerome Sands, who remains chairman, the company said Wednesay.
Tracy, who joined the firm in 1971 as a branch manager, was a vice chairman and head of the Robinson-Humphrey retail division at Smith Barney.
Robinson-Humphrey is a subsidiary of Smith Barney, which is a unit of Travelers Group Inc.

Sands said Tracy's promotion "evolves from a long-term succession plan initiated when we instituted an Office of the Chairman in 1994, but also very much reflects Tom's outstanding performance in managing our retail business."
Robinson-Humphrey's president, Roby Robinson, will continue in his current post and will serve as a member of a newly formed executive committee.
Founded in 1894, headquartered in Atlanta, the 102-year-old Robinson-Humphrey is engaged in full-service investment banking and securities brokerage.
